description: Users unable to create or modify policies in PolicyCenter. Error: 'Policy engine service unavailable'. Affects all tenants.
resolution_notes: Restarted policy engine service. Cleared stale cache. Policy creation restored. Root cause: service hung on memory leak.

summary: Intermittent button click failures in web UI
description: Users report claims are not being saved when they click 'Submit Claim' in the system. Sometimes works, sometimes doesn't. Happens in ClaimCenter claim entry form.
resolution_notes: Found race condition in claim submission handler. Updated JavaScript event listener to use debounce(500ms). Fixed in v2.1.8.

summary: Invoice generation stuck for batch > 5000 records
description: BillingCenter batch invoice generation fails when processing >5000 invoices in a single run. Error: 'memory exhausted in batch processor'.
resolution_notes: Increased heap size from 4GB to 8GB. Optimized batch query pagination. Now handles 50k+ invoices smoothly.

summary: Claim submission failing for large attachments - STILL OPEN
description: ClaimCenter claim submission fails when attaching files over 25MB. Investigation in progress, root cause not yet identified.
resolution_notes: Not yet resolved -- actively being investigated by ClaimCenter-Backend team.

summary: Payment gateway timeout errors - IN PROGRESS
description: BillingCenter payment processing intermittently times out when calling external payment gateway. Fix is being tested in staging.
resolution_notes: Fix in progress -- staging validation underway, not yet promoted to production.
